core_obligations: Condition (1) (proof lines 4093-4097): fibred in groupoids by the cited lemma.
Covering description (proof lines 4100-4111): coverings of the base stack are pulled back fppf coverings; X_ij, S_ij notation set up.
Descent for morphisms (proof lines 4112-4133): compatible isomorphisms varphi_i of the restrictions glue uniquely to varphi : L -> N by the descent proposition.
Descent for objects (proof lines 4135-4162): the descent datum (L_i, varphi_ij) with cocycle condition glues to a unique invertible L; ampleness of L descends by the cited lemma.
Second assertion (proof lines 4164-4167): since the base is a stack over Sch_fppf, the polarized stack is one too by the stacks-over-stacks lemma.
proof_roadmap: Verify condition (1) and describe coverings (proof lines 4093-4111).
Glue morphisms via descent of quasi-coherent modules (proof lines 4112-4133).
Glue objects and descend ampleness (proof lines 4135-4162).
Conclude the Sch_fppf statement formally (proof lines 4164-4167).
